messages:
Priya K: Quick mock — compare opens in a right-hand flyout anchored to row/card. Keeps list in context. https://redwood.design/mock/flyout.png :eyes:

Maya L: Love this. Small ask: keep filter shelf sticky so filters don't disappear when flyout opens.

Sam (frontend): Flyout is fine. Need focus trap + ESC to close. With virtualization we'll need to restore focus to the triggering element.

Alex R (a11y): Pin button must be a11y toggle. Use aria-pressed and sr-only state. Badges need better contrast.

Oliver M: Copy: badge should read "Latency (p95): 42 ms" not just "p95". Also show a small chevron for expandable details.

Priya K: Noted. Decision: persist filters, flyout with focus trap, pin uses aria-pressed, primary badge shows latency+unit. Owner: Priya. ETA: Tue.

DesignBot: Logged changes.
